versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g 94 of 133 Document ID 228: AUTOSAR_SWS_NetworkManagementInterface Specification of Network Management Interface AUTOSAR CP R21-11 Service Name Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown (draft) Syntax void Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown ( NetworkHandleType NetworkHandle, const uint8 * PncBitVectorPtr ) Service ID [hex] 0x28 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise NetworkHandle Identification of the NM-channel Parameters (in) PncBitVectorPtr Pointer to the bit vector with all PNC bits set to "1" which are indicated for a synchronized PNC shutdown Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Notification that the network management has received a PN shutdown message on a particular NM-channel. This is used to grant a nearly synchronized PNC shutdown across the entire PN topology. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Nm.h
